set.body:
Outcome: make the designer's success criterion testable before choosing or tuning its optimizer.

Scope: specify whole-contour subset selection for two conditions over a stimulus set, with optional per-drawing mode. Fix eligible contours, assignment/disjointness rules, target separation, weighting, retained-length/count constraints, and optional per-drawing imbalance bounds. Use a shared feature specification and L1 histogram distance/deviation first. Raw bin masses and contour lengths/counts are additive; document exactly how denominators are fixed or common target proportions are used so the implemented constraints remain linear. Do not describe arbitrary independently normalized histogram comparisons as linear.

Freeze before optimizer implementation:
- A versioned synthetic benchmark manifest with few-contour infeasible cases, varying contour budgets, unequal drawing sizes, tied scores, and known tiny optima; add only explicitly permitted natural drawings.
- Target properties, bin edges, normalization, quantitative nuisance tolerances, aggregation, ranked-splitting comparator, deterministic seeds/tie policy, time limits, and memory limits.
- Independent recomputation of achieved target separation and every constraint on output drawings. Preserve per-drawing results as well as set summaries.
- Acceptance: stronger target separation than ranked splitting on predefined feasible comparisons at the same tolerances/budgets; report ties, losses, infeasible inputs, and budget exhaustion. No fixture/tolerance changes after seeing optimizer results without a recorded new benchmark version.

Non-goals: transformation search; spatial union/overlap optimization; junction or MAT objectives/constraints; nonlinear normalization and perceptual/semantic claims. Spatial occupancy can later be encoded with extra binary variables, but that formulation is outside v1.
set.title: Freeze subset-designer objectives, constraints, fixtures, and budgets
